lines.text: The word of the LORD came to Haggai a second time that day, for Zerubbabel governor of Judah.
The LORD said He was about to shake the heavens and the sea.
The LORD said He would overturn royal thrones and destroy the power of the kingdoms of the nations.
The LORD said horses and their riders would fall, each by the sword of his brother.
On that day the LORD would make His servant Zerubbabel like His golden crown, because He had chosen him.
